reconciliation.note: Schema 2 removed the obsolete classicInertMoraleThresholds marker and split mixed rows into independently owned leaf diagnostics. Schema 3 established source-backed item and monster leaf families. This remediation pass resolved 1220 additional active rows by implementing item effects, monster weapons, missile items, special attacks, and exact zero-melee behavior; the remaining catalog contains only currently observed codes.

classic-synchronous-sound.requiredEvidence: A source action with a negative sound ID and a runtime test proving that script execution waits for playback completion.
classic-synchronous-sound.notes: Informational source behavior, not a fidelity fallback.

classic-monster-attack-sound-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic attack row 32 for Prelude to Pestilence monster 77 selects sound resource 623; an exact licensed sound plus an audible combat presentation test are required.
classic-monster-attack-sound-fallback.userAssistanceRequest: Provide or identify sound resource 623 from a licensed Classic Realmz installation and, if available, a save or reproduction sequence for Prelude to Pestilence Data BD battle 32 monster 77 so its exact attack presentation can be compared.
classic-monster-attack-sound-fallback.notes: The attack remains functional with a generic sound because resource 623 is not mapped or bundled. Substituting another sound would hide a missing asset.

classic-monster-item-materialization-fal.requiredEvidence: Resolve Half Truth item 950 stored spell ID 4412 from its exact Data NI record, then rerun monster inventory, equipment, and loot tests for monster 179.
classic-monster-item-materialization-fal.notes: The sole remaining row is dependent on an unresolved imported item identity, not missing generic Remake inventory behavior.

classic-monster-missile-item-fallback.requiredEvidence: For each remaining source monster, reconcile the authored missile chance with carried-slot-two item IDs 0, 4, or 422 and prove whether Classic treats the row as invalid, implicit ammunition, or a different item-selection path.
classic-monster-missile-item-fallback.notes: Exact missile-item behavior is implemented when a valid charged combat item occupies Classic carried slot two; the seven residual rows do not provide that valid identity.

classic-monster-weapon-materialization-f.requiredEvidence: Resolve Half Truth item 950 stored spell ID 4412 from its exact Data NI record, then rerun active weapon, combat, and loot tests for monster 179.
classic-monster-weapon-materialization-f.notes: The sole remaining row is the active-weapon projection of the same unresolved imported item 950.

inactive-custom-spell-definition.requiredEvidence: A source-backed consumer reference or reachable runtime route for the preserved custom spell definition.
inactive-custom-spell-definition.notes: Definitions remain preserved until an active consumer is proven.

inactive-macro-target.requiredEvidence: A reachable source call path proving that the unmarked Data ED3 target is callable in Classic.
inactive-macro-target.notes: The producer preserves the reference without making unreachable code callable.

inactive-scenario-rule-table.requiredEvidence: Classic load-profile control flow showing whether the scenario-local race or caste table replaces the selected shared table.
inactive-scenario-rule-table.notes: The shared rule table remains authoritative for these campaigns.

invalid-complex-spell-failure-sentinel.requiredEvidence: Classic selection-range evidence and a fixture showing that the invalid spell ID resolves to the default failure result.
invalid-complex-spell-failure-sentinel.notes: The preserved invalid sentinel already matches the observed Classic failure path.

invalid-scenario-spell-item-fallback.requiredEvidence: The packed Data NI field layout, the original item record, and a Classic use or inspection comparison for each impossible spell ID.
invalid-scenario-spell-item-fallback.notes: The item is preserved but deliberately inert until its packed identity is explained.

missing-macro-target.requiredEvidence: The originating source record, bounds behavior for the missing Data ED3 index, and a Classic gameplay or debugger observation at the call site.
missing-macro-target.notes: Remake currently uses a deterministic no-op instead of emulating an undefined record read.

missing-message.requiredEvidence: The source action, the complete message-table inventory, and a Classic comparison showing whether the reference is silent, invalid, or supplied externally.
missing-message.notes: The missing text affects presentation unless source control flow proves a behavioral dependency.

unresolved-classic-picture-resource.requiredEvidence: A licensed or user-owned Classic resource inventory containing picture IDs 758 and 20126 plus source records proving their intended display sites.
unresolved-classic-picture-resource.userAssistanceRequest: Provide or identify picture resource 758 from a licensed Classic installation and, if available, a save or reproduction sequence for Mithril Vault complex encounter 26; the second unresolved picture is ID 20126 used by War in the Sword Lands macro 2381.
unresolved-classic-picture-resource.notes: The picture remains unchanged when the optional external resource is absent.

unresolved-classic-sound-resource.requiredEvidence: A licensed or user-owned Classic sound inventory containing the exact referenced sound IDs and source records proving playback and wait behavior.
unresolved-classic-sound-resource.userAssistanceRequest: Provide or identify sound resource 23400 from a licensed Classic installation and, if available, a save or reproduction sequence for Assault on Giant Mountain Data DD land 0 record 60; that archive can then be checked against the other 74 unresolved sound IDs.
unresolved-classic-sound-resource.notes: The action remains a silent no-op when the optional external resource is absent.
